1.title: Drape tie around your collar
1.say: Lay your tie around your neck under the collar. Make the wide end hang much lower.
placements: wide end of tie → hanging down the front of your shirt on your right side with the tip low; in the video: wide blue striped end on the right side of the white shirt front
narrow skinny end of tie → hanging down the front of your shirt on your left side with the tip higher; in the video: narrow blue striped end on the left side of the white shirt front
watch_for: if both ends hang the same length the finished tie will be too short, start with the wide end much longer.
if the tie is twisted around your neck the back side will show, lay it flat with the smooth side facing out.
1.check_yourself: It should look like your tie is around your neck with both ends hanging down the front and the wide side much longer.

2.title: Cross wide end over skinny end
2.say: Hold the skinny end still in the middle of your chest. Bring the wide end across it to make a cross shape.
placements: wide end of tie → crossed over the front of the skinny end at the middle of your chest just below the collar; in the video: wide blue end lying over the narrow blue end in an X on the white shirt
watch_for: if the wide end goes under instead of over the knot will twist, the wide end should sit on top at the cross.
if the cross sits right at the neck the knot will be too tight, keep it a few inches below the collar.
2.check_yourself: It should look like the two ends form a clear X across the middle of your chest below the collar.

3.title: Bring wide end up through neck
3.say: Take the wide end behind the skinny end. Push it up through the opening around your neck from behind.
placements: wide end of tie → tucked behind the skinny end then pushed up through the neck opening with the tip pointing up; in the video: wide blue end poking up through the middle of the white collar
watch_for: if the wide end comes up in front of the cross it missed the opening, it should come up behind and through the neck opening.
if you pull all the way through you will undo the cross, leave the cross snug below the collar.
3.check_yourself: It should look like the wide end sticks straight up through the neck opening with the cross pinched tight below it.

4.title: Wrap wide end across the front
4.say: Bring the wide end down and across the front of the knot. Let the tip point out to the side.
placements: wide end of tie → brought down and across the front of the knot to form a flat horizontal band with the tip out to the side; in the video: wide blue end wrapped across the center with the tip to the side
watch_for: if the wrap rides up over the collar it is too high, keep the band flat across the middle of the knot.
if the wide end twists with the back side showing smooth it flat with the smooth side facing out.
4.check_yourself: It should look like a flat horizontal band lies across the middle of the knot with the wide tip sticking out to the side.

5.title: Pull wide end through front loop
5.say: Lift the wide end up to the neck. Push the tip down through the pocket under the band in front.
placements: wide end of tie → lifted up then pushed down through the front pocket under the band to hang centered over the skinny end; in the video: wide blue end hanging down through the middle of the front wrap
watch_for: if the tip goes behind the knot instead of through the pocket the knot will not hold, it must slide under the horizontal band in front.
if you pull sideways the band will bunch, pull straight down in the center.
5.check_yourself: It should look like the wide end hangs straight down through the middle of the front band over the skinny end.

6.title: Tighten knot and slide it up
6.say: Hold the skinny end and slide the knot up to the collar. Pinch the sides to shape a neat triangle.
placements: knot → slid up to sit centered just under the collar while holding the skinny end and pinched to a triangle; in the video: blue triangular knot centered under the white collar points
wide end of tie → pulled down to hang straight down the middle of the shirt over the skinny end; in the video: wide blue end hanging straight down the white shirt front
watch_for: if the knot leans to one side it is crooked, slide it straight and center it under the collar.
if the wide end ends far above your waist the start was too short, start next time with the wide end lower.
6.check_yourself: It should look like a neat triangle sits centered right under the collar with the wide end hanging straight down the front.
